2608.20529v1.title: Supersymmetric Virasoro Minimal Strings: Unified Perturbative and Non-Perturbative Treatment
2608.20529v1.abstract: There are four known ${N}{=}1$ supersymmetric Virasoro minimal string theories, naturally coming in two pairs and labeled as 0A$^\pm$ and 0B$^\pm$. We observe here that all four are naturally described in terms of solutions of an ordinary differential equation that describes certain random matrix models with positive spectra. Two new additional 0A$^-$ theories, which are unorientable, are naturally described by the framework. The formulation allows for simple computation of all perturbative amplitudes, and provides complete non-perturbative information as well. Our approach makes it clear why type 0A$^-$ can be deformed to include a gas of Ramond vertex insertions, which we fully describe, while type 0A$^+$ cannot. While it is known that the $c\rightarrow\infty$ limit reduces the 0A$^-$ and 0B$^-$ models to the familiar 0A and 0B JT supergravities of Stanford and Witten, the same limit for the plus pair reduces to non-perturbative completions of ordinary JT gravity, one of which is known. Large families of ${N}{=}2$ and ${N}{=}4$ supersymmetric analogues of the Virasoro minimal strings are also proposed and explored in detail, using the same approach.

classification.title_zh: 超对称Virasoro最小弦：微扰与非微扰的统一处理
classification.abstract_zh: 已知有四种N=1超对称Virasoro最小弦理论，自然成对出现并标记为0A±和0B±。我们观察到，这四个理论都可以自然地用某个描述具有正谱的随机矩阵模型的常微分方程的解来描述。该框架还自然描述了两种新的附加0A−理论，它们是不可定向的。该表述允许简单计算所有微扰振幅，并提供完整的非微扰信息。我们的方法明确了为什么0A−类型可以变形为包含拉蒙德顶点插入气体（我们对此进行了完整描述），而0A+类型则不能。虽然已知c→∞极限将0A−和0B−模型约化为Stanford和Witten的熟悉0A和0B JT超引力，但正号对的同一极限则约化为普通JT引力的非微扰完成，其中之一是已知的。我们还使用相同方法提出并详细探讨了N=2和N=4超对称Virasoro最小弦的大类类比。

2608.20599v1.title: From Gross-Manes to Alday-Maldacena
2608.20599v1.abstract: Minimal surfaces govern the classical limit of several important observables in string theory. Two basic examples are the Gross--Manes saddle for high-energy string scattering in flat space and the Alday--Maldacena surface for gluon scattering at strong coupling in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM. In this paper we study a family of null polygonal minimal surfaces in AdS interpolating between these two regimes by moving the cusps from a small region deep in the bulk to the AdS boundary. We do this both numerically and -- in interesting simplifying limits -- analytically. In particular, we derive the leading AdS-radius correction around flat space and show that the resulting classical amplitude agrees with the recent prediction of Alday, Armanini, H\"aring, and Zhiboedov, supporting an underlying worldsheet description of their bootstrap construction.

classification.title_zh: 从Gross-Manes到Alday-Maldacena
classification.abstract_zh: 极小曲面支配了弦论中几个重要观测量的经典极限。两个基本例子是平直空间中高能弦散射的Gross--Manes鞍点，以及${\cal N}=4$ SYM中强耦合胶子散射的Alday--Maldacena曲面。在本文中，我们研究了AdS中一族零多边形极小曲面，通过将尖点从深处体区域移动到AdS边界，在这两种机制之间进行插值。我们做了数值研究，并在有趣的简化极限中做了解析研究。特别地，我们推导了平直空间周围的AdS半径前导修正，并表明所得经典振幅与Alday、Armanini、H\"aring和Zhiboedov最近的预言一致，支持了其自举构造的底层世界面描述。

2608.21178v1.title: Quantum Horizon Tadpole and Emergence of a de Sitter Interior
2608.21178v1.abstract: In a recent paper \cite{Chu:2026dhx}, the quantum stability of the fuzzy sphere was established at large but finite $N$. In addition, a tadpole was identified for the scaling fluctuation mode of the matrix geometry. In this paper, we show that the tadpole generates a positive surface tension and tends to contract the sphere if the horizon is left isolated. However, when the horizon is coupled to gravity, the tadpole requires the bulk geometry to adjust according to the junction condition of general relativity. Assuming a static, spherically symmetric and non-singular vacuum interior, pure de Sitter space is selected. The matching also fixes an intriguing large-$N$ soldering relation between the de Sitter time inside and the Schwarzschild time outside. Potential cosmological implications are discussed.

classification.title_zh: 量子视界Tadpole与de Sitter内部的涌现
classification.abstract_zh: 在最近的一篇论文中，模糊球在大而有限的N下的量子稳定性已被确立，同时识别出矩阵几何缩放涨落模式的一个tadpole。本文表明，若视界孤立，该tadpole产生正表面张力并倾向于使球收缩；然而，当视界与引力耦合时，tadpole要求体几何根据广义相对论的连接条件进行调整。在假设静态、球对称、无奇性真空内部的情况下，选择了纯de Sitter空间。匹配还确定了内部de Sitter时间与外部Schwarzschild时间之间的一个有趣的大N焊接关系。文中讨论了潜在的宇宙学意义。

2604.11896v2.title: Strong coupling dynamics of defect RG flows in ABJM
2604.11896v2.abstract: Wilson loop operators in ABJM theory provide a rich arena for studying defect conformal field theories (dCFTs) and the renormalization group (RG) flows connecting them. While these are well understood at weak coupling, a complete strong-coupling picture remains an open problem. In this paper, we present a systematic strong-coupling analysis of the fixed points and operator spectrum underlying defect RG flows in ABJM, via holography. By examining fluctuations of fundamental strings in the AdS$_4 \times \mathbb{CP}^3$ background around classical AdS$_2$ solutions, we map worldsheet excitations to the operators in the dual dCFT which are responsible for the flows and determine their scaling dimensions, including subleading corrections from one-loop worldsheet effects. We show how different boundary conditions on string coordinates correspond to distinct operators and provide a geometric realization of the RG flows through interpolating boundary conditions. We apply this framework to fermionic 1/2 BPS, bosonic 1/6 BPS, and non-supersymmetric Wilson loops, establishing a coherent strong-coupling picture in which the 1/2 BPS loop is IR stable, the 1/6 BPS loop acts as a saddle point, and the non-supersymmetric configuration emerges as a natural UV fixed point. We also advance a proposal for the holographic dual of a second non-supersymmetric loop, in terms of averaging over Dirichlet boundary conditions.

classification.title_zh: ABJM 中缺陷 RG 流的强耦合动力学
classification.abstract_zh: ABJM 理论中的 Wilson 圈算符为研究缺陷共形场论（dCFT）及其之间的重整化群（RG）流提供了丰富的舞台。虽然这些在弱耦合下已被很好理解，但其完整的强耦合图像仍是一个开放问题。在本文中，我们通过全息方法，对 ABJM 中缺陷 RG 流背后的不动点和算子谱进行了系统的强耦合分析。通过考察 AdS_4 × CP^3 背景中围绕经典 AdS_2 解的基本弦涨落，我们将世界sheet激发映射到驱动这些流的对偶 dCFT 中的算子，并确定其标度维度，包括来自单圈世界sheet效应的次领头阶修正。我们展示了弦坐标上的不同边界条件如何对应不同的算子，并通过插值边界条件给出了 RG 流的几何实现。我们将此框架应用于费米子 1/2 BPS、玻色子 1/6 BPS 以及非超对称 Wilson 圈，建立了一个自洽的强耦合图像：其中 1/2 BPS 圈是红外稳定的，1/6 BPS 圈充当鞍点，而非超对称构型则作为自然的紫外不动点出现。我们还提出了第二个非超对称圈的全息对偶建议，即对 Dirichlet 边界条件取平均。

2604.26038v2.title: The Super Virasoro Minimal String from 3d Supergravity
2604.26038v2.abstract: The super Virasoro minimal string is defined by coupling spacelike and timelike super Liouville theories on the worldsheet. There are four different theories 0A$^\pm$ and 0B$^\pm$ depending on discrete choices on the worldsheet. We show that these theories arise naturally from quantization of 3d supergravity, and the amplitudes compute the dimension ($+$) or superdimension ($-$) of the space of $\mathcal{N}=1$ superconformal blocks modulo crossing symmetry. Both 0A$^+$ and 0B$^+$ are perturbatively dual to the same matrix integral as the bosonic Virasoro minimal string, while 0B$^-$ is dual to a matrix integral with an inverse square root singularity. We show that all non-trivial perturbative amplitudes of the 0A$^-$ theory vanish.

classification.title_zh: 来自三维超引力的超 Virasoro 极小弦
classification.abstract_zh: 超 Virasoro 极小弦由世界面上类空与类时超 Liouville 理论的耦合定义。根据世界面上的分立选择，存在四种不同理论 0A^± 和 0B^±。我们证明这些理论自然地来自三维超引力的量子化，其振幅计算 N=1 超共形块模掉交叉对称性的空间的维数（+）或超维数（−）。0A^+ 和 0B^+ 在微扰论中与玻色 Virasoro 极小弦的同一个矩阵积分对偶，而 0B^− 对偶到具有平方根倒数奇异性的矩阵积分。我们证明 0A^− 理论的所有非平凡微扰振幅都为零。

2608.07919v2.title: The gravity side of the $p$-adic AdS$_2$/CFT$_1$
2608.07919v2.abstract: By means of a higher-dimensional embedding approach, together with the study of distance, measure, and curvature, we construct a gravitational theory on the two-dimensional space over $p$-adic numbers. Before constructing this gravitational theory, we provide supplementary calculations based on existing literature and justify the validity of the gravitational theory by comparison with the real-number case, for instance, the curvatures of de Sitter(dS), anti-de Sitter(AdS), and Euclidean space should be positive, negative, and zero, respectively. Finally, as an example on the gravity side of the $p$-adic AdS$_2$/CFT$_1$, we present the action for a scalar field coupled to gravity.

classification.title_zh: p进AdS_2/CFT_1的引力侧
classification.abstract_zh: 通过高维嵌入方法，并结合距离、测度与曲率的研究，我们在p进数上的二维空间上构造了一个引力理论。在构造该引力理论之前，论文基于现有文献提供了补充计算，并通过与实数情形的对比论证了该引力理论的有效性，例如de Sitter(dS)、反de Sitter(AdS)和欧几里得空间的曲率应分别为正、负和零。最后，作为p进AdS_2/CFT_1引力侧的一个例子，我们给出了与引力耦合的标量场的作用量。

2608.20526v1.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Merging of Multidimensional QCD Equations of State
2608.20526v1.abstract: We present a thermodynamically consistent framework for merging complementary models into a multidimensional QCD equation of state. An internal mixing variable is determined by minimizing a single grand potential at fixed temperature and baryon chemical potential, ensuring thermodynamic consistency and stability. Interactions between the components allow for a crossover, a critical endpoint, and a first-order transition. As a proof of principle, we merge a quantum van der Waals hadron-resonance-gas model with a holographic Einstein--Maxwell--Dilaton model. The resulting equation of state reproduces the appropriate description in each regime, agrees well with available lattice-QCD results, and is suitable for heavy-ion phenomenology over a broad range of temperature and baryon chemical potential.

2608.21518v1.title: On flat space limits of $AdS_4$ black holes
2608.21518v1.abstract: With a view towards understanding flat space holography, we study the flat space limit of asymptotically $AdS_4$ black holes in gauged $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity. Using holographic renormalisation, we carefully analyse the flat space limit of the on-shell action of various black holes in this setting and make explicit the states that contribute to the partition function in this limit. We find several features: large black holes lead to a divergence in the partition function which can be understood as a thermodynamic volume divergence. Meanwhile, semiclassically, small black holes reproduce the partition function of their flat space counterparts, and we clarify the mapping between BPS, (near-)extremal or non-extremal black holes on both sides for charged and rotating solutions. Finally, by studying a suitable flat limit of the BPS Kerr-Newman-$AdS_4$ black hole in M-theory, we obtain a charged BPS solution in flat space. On the dual side, we determine a Carrollian-like limit on the known ABJM partition function on $S^1\times S^2$ at large $N$, and show that it reproduces the correct entropy of the BPS charged black hole in asymptotically flat space.

classification.title_zh: 关于 AdS4 黑洞的平直时空极限
classification.abstract_zh: 着眼于理解平直时空全息，我们研究规范 N=2 超引力中渐近 AdS4 黑洞的平直时空极限。利用全息重整化，我们仔细分析该背景下各种黑洞 on-shell 作用量的平直时空极限，并明确在此极限下贡献配分函数的状态。我们发现若干特征：大黑洞导致配分函数中的发散，可理解为热力学体积发散。同时，在半经典层面，小黑洞重现其平直时空对应物的配分函数，并且我们阐明了带电荷和转动解在 BPS、(近)极值或非极值黑洞两侧之间的映射。最后，通过研究 M 理论中 BPS Kerr-Newman-AdS4 黑洞的合适平直极限，我们得到平直时空中的带电 BPS 解。在对偶侧，我们确定了已知的 S^1×S^2 上大 N ABJM 配分函数的类 Carroll 极限，并证明它重现渐近平直时空中 BPS 带电黑洞的正确熵。

2608.22013v1.title: Holographic SU(3) color superconductivity at finite baryon chemical potential
2608.22013v1.abstract: We present a holographic model of SU(3) color superconductivity (CSC) where a global color symmetry is spontaneously broken by a diquark condensate at finite baryon chemical potential. At $\mu_b=0$, a systematic stability analysis over all SU(3) channels recovers the known SU(2) s+p competition. Based on that, the finite $\mu_b$ further generalizes the s-wave order to an S1+iS2 structure. We find that $\mu_b$ enhances the critical temperature of the S1+iS2 phase while suppressing the p-wave -- the latter vanishes beyond a certain $\mu_b$ when backreaction is included. This opposite trend reshapes the phase diagram: with increasing $\mu_b$, the balanced S+ phase (S1=S2) takes over the entire color-superconducting region. Our non-Abelian framework provides a concrete holographic description of global SU(3) symmetry breaking, relevant for understanding color-superconducting phases in dense QCD and may offer new insights into the physics of neutron-star interiors.

2608.22609v1.title: Genus-Two Contributions to Late-Time Correlators in JT Gravity
2608.22609v1.abstract: In this work, we analyze the late-time two-point correlation function in Jackiw--Teitelboim gravity, focusing on the genus-two ($g=2$) contribution associated with two baby universes. Extending the analysis of the single-baby-universe ($g=1$) case, we formulate an amplitude describing the emission and absorption of two baby universes during the evolution of the Hartle--Hawking state. This formulation reduces the problem to a moduli-space integral involving the Weil--Petersson volume $V_{0,3}$. To evaluate this integral, we decompose $V_{0,3}$ into contributions from Kontsevich graphs and extend the no-shortcut condition to the relevant genus-two strip geometries. Combined with the strip approximation, this decomposition reorganizes the moduli-space integral into a finite sum of contributions associated with distinct geometric configurations. We then explicitly evaluate the strip-geometry contributions corresponding to the emission of two baby universes and determine their contribution to the genus-two late-time two-point correlation function. Our results suggest that the strip approximation, together with the no-shortcut condition, provides a useful analytic framework for studying higher-genus geometries containing multiple wormholes.

classification.title_zh: JT引力中晚期关联函数的亏格二贡献
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分析Jackiw-Teitelboim引力中的晚期两点关联函数，重点研究与两个婴儿宇宙相关的亏格二（g=2）贡献。在单婴儿宇宙（g=1）情形分析的基础上，构造描述Hartle-Hawking态演化过程中两个婴儿宇宙发射与吸收的振幅。该构造将问题化为涉及Weil-Petersson体积V_{0,3}的模空间积分。为计算该积分，将V_{0,3}分解为Kontsevich图的贡献，并将无捷径条件推广到相关亏格二条带几何。结合条带近似，该分解将模空间积分重组为与不同几何构型对应的有限项贡献之和。随后显式计算对应于两个婴儿宇宙发射的条带几何贡献，并确定它们对亏格二晚期两点关联函数的贡献。结果表明，条带近似与无捷径条件为研究包含多个虫洞的高亏格几何提供了有效的解析框架。

2608.22625v1.title: Higher-spin charges and the $L_{\Lambda} w_{1 + \infty}$ algebra in (A)dS$_4$
2608.22625v1.abstract: We consider $(3+1)$-dimensional asymptotically locally (anti-)de Sitter ((A)dS$_4$) spacetimes with boundary conditions allowing for gravitational flux. We construct an infinite tower of higher-spin charges as perturbative solutions in the cosmological constant $\Lambda$ to a hierarchy of evolution equations resulting from an asymptotic expansion of the Einstein equations. We show that these charges canonically realize the $\Lambda$-deformed $w_{1+\infty}$ algebra ($L_{\Lambda} w_{1+\infty}$) on a restricted gravitational phase space, thereby extending the higher-spin symmetry structure of asymptotically flat spacetimes to asymptotically (A)dS spacetimes. We further construct the curved-space counterparts of conformally soft gravitons directly in terms of spacetime data. We show that they are primaries with respect to an $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$ subalgebra of the (A)dS$_4$ isometry algebra and that their Poisson brackets with the quadratic higher-spin charges reproduce the $\Lambda$-deformed celestial operator product expansion proposed by Taylor and Zhu. Our results establish the bulk gravitational origin of the $L_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ symmetry and extend the celestial bulk-boundary dictionary to asymptotically (A)dS$_4$ gravity.

classification.title_zh: (A)dS$_4$ 中的高自旋荷与 $L_{\Lambda} w_{1 + \infty}$ 代数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑 (3+1) 维渐近局部（反）德西特（(A)dS$_4$）时空，其边界条件允许引力通量。我们通过对爱因斯坦方程渐近展开得到的演化方程层级构造一个无穷高自旋荷塔，作为宇宙学常数 $\Lambda$ 的微扰解。我们证明这些荷在受限引力相空间上正则实现 $\Lambda$ 形变的 $w_{1+\infty}$ 代数（$L_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$），从而将渐近平坦时空的高自旋对称结构推广到渐近 (A)dS 时空。我们进一步直接用时空数据构造共形软引力子的弯曲空间对应物。我们证明它们相对于 (A)dS$_4$ 等距代数的 $\mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{R})$ 子代数是主态，并且它们与二次高自旋荷的泊松括号重现了 Taylor 和 Zhu 提出的 $\Lambda$ 形变天球算子乘积展开。我们的结果确立了 $L_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ 对称性的体引力起源，并将天球体-边界字典推广到渐近 (A)dS$_4$ 引力。

2608.22855v1.title: Bouncing shellworld embedded in charged AdS spacetime
2608.22855v1.abstract: We investigate the cosmological evolution of a spherical brane within the shellworld (dark bubble) scenario embedded in a five-dimensional charged AdS bulk spacetime. For zero or small value of the brane cosmological constant, the shellworld universe has a nonsingular bouncing and cyclic nature with the bounce induced by the charge parameter of the bulk spacetime. On large value of the brane cosmological constant, the shellworld undergoes a nonsingular bounce and expands eternally. Under certain conditions, the brane bounces outside the bulk horizons, leading to a geometrical resolution of the Cauchy horizon instability present in standard braneworld models. Furthermore, analysis of linear scalar perturbations reveals that test scalar field modes remain regular and non-divergent across the bounce. Finally, we incorporate uniformly distributed long strings in the bulk and demonstrate that the bounce still persists while avoiding the horizon instability.

classification.title_zh: 嵌入荷电 AdS 时空中的反弹壳世界
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了嵌入在五维荷电 AdS 体时空中的壳世界（暗气泡）场景里一个球形膜的宇宙学演化。当膜宇宙学常数为零或较小时，壳世界宇宙具有无奇点反弹和循环性质，反弹由体时空的电荷参数诱导。当膜宇宙学常数较大时，壳世界经历无奇点反弹并永恒膨胀。在某些条件下，膜在体视界外部反弹，从而从几何上解决了标准膜世界模型中存在的柯西视界不稳定性。此外，线性标量扰动分析表明，测试标量场模式在反弹过程中保持规则且不发散。最后，我们在体时空中纳入均匀分布的长弦，并证明反弹仍然持续，同时避免了视界不稳定性。
classification.one_liner: 研究发现荷电 AdS 体时空中的壳世界膜宇宙可实现无奇点反弹，并利用几何方式规避柯西视界不稳定性。

2608.22952v1.title: A pedagogical introduction to invariant theory and finite-$N$ holography
2608.22952v1.abstract: These lectures provide a pedagogical introduction to the study of finite-$N$ physics of the AdS/CFT correspondence. More specifically we develop the consequences of the trace relations for the space of gauge invariant operators, using powerful methods from invariant theory. Our key conclusions are \begin{itemize} \item that the complete set of trace relations can be solved, leaving a non-redundant set of gauge invariant operators, \item that this non-redundant set can be generated using two types of generators, called primary and secondary invariants, and \item that the primary invariants acquire a natural interpretation as perturbative gravitational degrees of freedom, while the secondary algebra encodes non-perturbative effects of the dual gravitational theory. \end{itemize}

classification.title_zh: 不变理论与有限 N 全息的教学性导引
classification.abstract_zh: 这些讲义对 AdS/CFT 对应中有限 N 物理的研究作了教学性介绍。更具体地，我们利用不变理论的强大方法，推导迹关系对规范不变算子空间的影响。主要结论是：完整的迹关系集合可以被求解，留下一个无冗余的规范不变算子集合；该无冗余集合可以由两类生成元生成，分别称为主不变量与次要不变量；主不变量自然被解释为微扰引力自由度，而次级代数编码对偶引力理论的非微扰效应。
classification.one_liner: 利用不变理论方法研究 AdS/CFT 中有限 N 规范不变算符空间的迹关系，给出主/次级不变量的生成及其引力诠释。

2608.23111v1.title: A Third-Quantized Description of Spacetime Wormholes in AdS/CFT
2608.23111v1.abstract: We propose an extension of AdS/CFT in which quantum gravitational wavefunctions of connected bulk geometries are assembled into a Fock space of universes. Splitting and joining interactions in a third-quantized Hamiltonian then provide a quantum description of changes in bulk connectivity and topology. Reduced phase-space quantization supplies the physical one-universe Hilbert space and a radial Schr\"odinger evolution with respect to which the topology-changing interactions are ordered. We develop the construction concretely in AdS$_3$ gravity with a torus boundary, where these ingredients can be described explicitly. The light spectrum is treated as fixed, non-normalizable background data, whereas the normalizable states above the black-hole threshold are quantized as dynamical modes. A conventional boundary theory is selected by choosing a coherent state whose universe-field expectation value, together with the fixed background contribution, yields consistent CFT data at the asymptotic boundary. Generic one-universe wavefunctions need not admit such an interpretation. This raises the possibility that CFT-realizable wavefunctions are nongeneric in the gravitational state space and are not closed under arbitrary superpositions of gravitational states. The known two-torus spacetime-wormhole amplitude, which lies at the heart of the factorization problem, provides concrete input for the topology-changing interactions of the third-quantized theory. A complementary cutting-and-gluing description yields an effective ensemble interpretation when the resulting gravitational sectors admit consistent boundary-theory interpretations, without assuming a fundamental ensemble of boundary theories. We also discuss replica wormholes and baby-universe processes within the same framework.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT中时空虫洞的第三量子化描述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出AdS/CFT的一种扩展，将连通体量子引力的波函数组装成宇宙的Fock空间。第三量子化哈密顿量中的分裂与并合相互作用则提供了对体连接性和拓扑变化的量子描述。约化相空间量子化给出了物理单宇宙希尔伯特空间和一个径向薛定谔演化，拓扑变化相互作用按照该演化排序。我们在具有环面边界的AdS_3引力中具体构建了这一框架，其中这些要素可以被显式描述。光谱被视为固定的、非正规化的背景数据，而黑洞阈值之上的正规化态则被量子化为动力学模式。通过选择相干态来确定一个常规的边界理论，该相干态的宇宙场期望值连同固定的背景贡献在渐近边界处给出一致的CFT数据。一般的单宇宙波函数不一定允许这种解释。这提出了CFT可实现波函数在引力态空间中可能是非典型的，并且在引力态的任意叠加下并不封闭的可能性。已知的双环面时空虫洞振幅——它位于因子化问题的核心——为第三量子化理论的拓扑变化相互作用提供了具体输入。一种互补的切割-粘合描述在引力扇区允许一致的边界理论解释时给出有效的系综解释，而无需假设边界理论的基本系综。我们还在同一框架内讨论了replica wormhole和婴儿宇宙过程。
classification.one_liner: 提出在AdS/CFT中引入第三量子化框架，将连通几何的量子引力波函数组装成宇宙的Fock空间，以描述时空拓扑变化，并探讨了因子化问题与虫洞。

2608.23298v1.title: The ETH matrix model for DSSYK: non-perturbative corrections and intersection theory
2608.23298v1.abstract: At leading order in the genus expansion the ETH matrix model for DSSYK reproduces its correlators by construction, while its higher-genus corrections are conjectured to capture higher-topology contributions in the dual sine-dilaton gravity -- a correspondence established so far only for the disk and the wormhole. At fixed genus the correlators are built from discrete volumes $N_{g,n}$, polynomial in $q$-deformed zeta values $\zeta_q(2k)$ with $q=e^{-\lambda}$, $\lambda$ being the DSSYK coupling. These lie in the ring of quasimodular forms generated by the Eisenstein series $E_2,E_4,E_6$, whose $S$-duality yields an exact closed form for the leading non-perturbative correction as $\lambda\to0$, controlled by $\widetilde q=e^{-4\pi^2/\lambda}$. Known at disk level, this scale is shown here to govern the fixed-genus, higher-boundary amplitudes as well. We show that the term linear in $\widetilde q$, at leading order in $\lambda$, is captured entirely by the $q$-deformed Weil--Petersson volumes, and reduces to a finite sum of intersection numbers of $\kappa$-classes on the moduli space $\overline{\mathcal M}_{g,n}$ of stable curves, computable without repeating the topological recursion that produced the $N_{g,n}$. We tabulate it for every $(g,n)$ whose $q$-deformed volume is known in closed form, and extend it to $(3,1),(3,2),(4,1)$, where none is available. The construction is not restricted to leading order: we work out $O(\widetilde q^2)$ for the same cases.

classification.title_zh: DSSYK 的 ETH 矩阵模型：非微扰修正与交点理论
classification.abstract_zh: 在亏格展开的首阶，DSSYK 的 ETH 矩阵模型按其构造复现了其关联函数；其更高亏格修正被猜想捕获对偶正弦-膨胀子引力中的更高拓扑贡献——该对应迄今仅在圆盘和虫洞情形下建立。固定亏格下，关联函数由离散体积 N_{g,n} 构成，它们是 q 变形 zeta 值 ζ_q(2k) 的多项式，其中 q=e^{-λ}，λ 为 DSSYK 耦合常数。这些量位于由艾森斯坦级数 E_2,E_4,E_6 生成的拟模形式环中；其 S 对偶给出当 λ→0 时领头非微扰修正的精确闭式，由 \tilde q=e^{-4π^2/λ} 控制。该标度此前在圆盘级别已知，本文证明它也支配固定亏格、更高边界的振幅。我们证明，在 λ 的首阶，\tilde q 的线性项完全由 q 变形 Weil-Petersson 体积所捕获，并可约化为稳定曲线模空间 \overline M_{g,n} 上 κ 类交点数的一个有限和；计算无需重复生成 N_{g,n} 的拓扑递归。我们为所有 q 变形体积已知闭式的 (g,n) 列出该和，并将其推广到 (3,1),(3,2),(4,1)，这些情形尚无闭式可用。该构造不限于首阶：我们对相同情形计算了 O(\tilde q^2) 项。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明 DSSYK 的 ETH 矩阵模型中固定亏格振幅的领头非微扰修正可由 q 变形 Weil-Petersson 体积和稳定曲线模空间上的 κ 类交点有限和完全刻画，并对多组 (g,n) 给出显式表。

2608.23378v1.title: Landau theory, effective temperature, and tricritical phenomena in a holographic nonequilibrium steady state
2608.23378v1.abstract: We investigate the critical exponents $(\gamma,\nu)$ at the current-driven tricritical point (TCP) associated with chiral symmetry breaking in a nonequilibrium steady state described by the D3/D7 model. In the symmetry-broken phase, we find that, unlike in the conventional Landau theory, both $\gamma$ and $\nu$ can take values different from those predicted by the Landau theory and depend on the path along which the TCP is approached in the phase diagram. However, when the TCP is approached with the ratio of the effective temperature to the heat bath temperature, $T_{*}/T$, held fixed, the critical exponents agree with those of the Landau theory. These results suggest that the critical phenomena at the current-driven TCP may be described by the Landau theory along the $T_{*}/T$-fixed line, whereas a nontrivial extension of the Landau theory is required for a more general description of the critical phenomena along arbitrary paths.

classification.title_zh: 朗道理论、有效温度与全息非平衡稳态中的三临界现象
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由D3/D7模型描述的非平衡稳态中，与手征对称性破缺相关的电流驱动三临界点（TCP）处的临界指数 $(\gamma,\nu)$。在对称性破缺相中，我们发现，与传统朗道理论不同，$\gamma$ 和 $\nu$ 都可以取不同于朗道理论预测的值，并且依赖于相图中接近TCP的路径。然而，当以有效温度与热浴温度之比 $T_{*}/T$ 固定来接近TCP时，临界指数与朗道理论的结果一致。这些结果表明，沿 $T_{*}/T$ 固定线，电流驱动TCP处的临界现象可以用朗道理论描述；而要更一般地描述沿任意路径的临界现象，则需要朗道理论的一种非平凡推广。

1904.06930v2.title: Comments on holographic entanglements in cutoff AdS
1904.06930v2.abstract: We study two-interval holographic entanglement entropy and entanglement wedge cross section in cutoff AdS. In particular, we investigate phase transitions of them. For two-interval entanglement entropy, the transition point monotonically decreases with a deformation parameter, which means that by the TT deformation the degrees of freedom in subsystems are decreasing. This implies that the effect of the TT deformation can be regarded as the rescaling of the energy scale. We also study entanglement wedge cross section in cutoff AdS, and our result implies that for the entanglement of purification in the TT deformed CFTs phase transition could occur even for fixed subsystems.

classification.title_zh: 关于截断 AdS 中全息纠缠的评述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究截断 AdS 中两区间全息纠缠熵与纠缠楔截面，特别考察它们的相变。对两区间纠缠熵，相变点随形变参数单调下降，意味着通过 TT 形变，子系统中的自由度在减少。这表明 TT 形变的效果可视为能量尺度的重新标定。我们还研究截断 AdS 中的纠缠楔截面，结果表明在 TT 形变 CFT 中，即使对于固定子系统，纠缠纯化的相变也可能发生。

2511.10430v4.title: Fuzzy Black Holes from Mass Generation in Matrix Compactification
2511.10430v4.abstract: We investigate a mechanism for generating mass terms in the IKKT and BFSS matrix theories through compactification on a torus and the derivation of a zero-mode effective theory, emphasising the crucial role of fermionic boundary conditions. Extending a recent proposal developed for the IKKT model to the BFSS framework, we explore a broader class of mixed fermionic boundary conditions in both theories. This choice leads to a distinct effective theory with intermediate features, where a mass term is generated together with fermionic zero modes. In the BFSS case, this setup further allows for the construction of black hole solutions. The resulting geometry takes the form of a fuzzy sphere, with quantum excitations in the fermionic sector accounting for the corresponding black hole entropy.

classification.title_zh: 矩阵紧致化中由质量生成产生的模糊黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了通过环面紧致化以及在推导零模有效理论的过程中，在IKKT和BFSS矩阵理论里生成质量项的机制，并强调费米子边界条件的关键作用。我们将最近为IKKT模型提出的方案扩展到BFSS框架，并在两种理论中探索了一类更广泛的混合费米子边界条件。这一选择导致了一个具有中间特征的不同有效理论，其中质量项与费米子零模同时产生。在BFSS情形下，该设定还进一步允许构造黑洞解。所得几何呈模糊球面形式，费米子扇区中的量子激发对应相应的黑洞熵。
classification.one_liner: 在矩阵模型环面紧致化中通过混合费米子边界条件生成质量项，并在BFSS框架下得到模糊球几何且费米子激发承载熵的黑洞解。

2511.10557v2.title: Symmetries, operators and correlators in $J\bar{T}$ deformed CFTs
2511.10557v2.abstract: We use symmetries to define a new class of operators and compute their correlation functions in the $J\bar{T}$-deformed conformal field theory on the plane, following the strategy developed in [1]. The symmetry algebra of the deformed theory consists of a local Virasoro-Kac-Moody algebra in the left-moving sector and a non-local counterpart in the right-moving sector. This algebraic structure guides the definition of distinct operator classes. In this paper, we focus on two types of operators: Dressed operators transform as primaries under the symmetries and depend on non-local coordinates, which involve integration over a region. Physical operators, introduced in this work, depend only on local quantities at the classical level and can be expressed in a manageable way in terms of dressed operators and currents. At the quantum level, we assume the existence of dressed operators and the Ward identities that relate them. The physical operators are then defined via the dressed operators and currents, the expression of which is a natural uplifting of the classical version. This formulation allows the powerful constraints of conformal symmetry to be leveraged for computing physical observables. Consequently, we employ conformal perturbation theory to compute the two-point and $N$-point functions of physical operators. In momentum space, we sum the most UV-sensitive contributions to all orders; the results show precise agreement with string theory predictions. In position space, the leading-log contributions to the two-point correlators are summed to all orders in the deformation parameter, revealing non-perturbative behavior.

classification.title_zh: J\bar{T} 形变共形场论中的对称性、算符与关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用对称性定义了一类新算符，并按照文献[1]的策略计算平面上 J\bar{T} 形变共形场论中的关联函数。形变理论的对称代数由左移扇区的局域 Virasoro-Kac-Moody 代数与右移扇区的非局域对应部分组成。这一代数结构指导了不同算符类的定义。本文聚焦两类算符：Dressed 算符在对称性下作为 primary 变换，并依赖于包含区域积分的非局域坐标；物理算符是本文引入的，在经典层面只依赖局域量，并可用 dressed 算符和流以易处理的方式表达。在量子层面，我们假设 dressed 算符存在且满足联系它们的 Ward 恒等式，物理算符则通过 dressed 算符和流的自然量子化提升来定义。这一表述使得共形对称性的强大约束可用于计算物理可观测量。因此，我们采用共形微扰论计算物理算符的两点和 N 点函数。在动量空间中，我们将最紫外敏感贡献求和到所有阶，结果与弦论预言精确一致；在位置空间中，两点关联函数的主导对数贡献在形变参数下被求和到所有阶，展现出非微扰行为。
classification.one_liner: 利用 J\bar{T} 形变 CFT 的对称代数定义新算符类，通过共形微扰论计算关联函数，并与弦论预言一致，显示非微扰行为。

2602.18924v3.title: Critical Temperatures of Excited Holographic Superconductors in Born--Infeld Electrodynamics on a Reissner--Nordstr\"om--AdS Background
2602.18924v3.abstract: We study the ground state (GS) and the two lowest excited states (ES1, ES2) of a probe holographic superconductor with Born-Infeld (BI) electrodynamics on a charged Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS) black hole background. The small-to-large black hole (SBH/LBH) transition used to modulate the boundary theory requires the electric charge Q: the neutral Schwarzschild-AdS metric admits only one positive horizon for any M,L^2>0 and cannot support such a transition. Working on the correctly identified RN-AdS geometry, we set up the scalar/BI-gauge probe sector, formulate the linear eigenvalue problem for the onset of condensation, and solve it by a shooting method. We obtain T_c of GS, ES1, ES2 at three representative pressures (P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c) and five values of the BI parameter b in {0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1. T_c increases monotonically with P and is suppressed by b for all three states, more for the excited states (~2% for GS versus ~10-27% for ES1/ES2 at b=5 Q^-1). A finer scan in b shows the suppression follows a quadratic law T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2, with alpha(GS)~7.4e-4, alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3, alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2, consistent with the radial profiles of the threshold modes: the ground-state mode is concentrated near the horizon, while the nodal excited-state modes extend further into the bulk. We present this as a nodal-sensitivity picture rather than a proven mechanism, and make it concrete with an explicit leading-order BI correction to the bulk gauge field: this differential coupling between nonlinear electrodynamics and the node structure of excited condensates has not previously been isolated and quantified, independently of the back-reacted problem left to a companion study. These results clarify how BI nonlinearity interacts with the nodal structure of excited states, giving a sharper linear baseline for the back-reacted, finite-temperature holographic superconductor.

classification.title_zh: Reissner-Nordström-AdS背景下Born-Infeld电动力学的激发全息超导体临界温度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在带电荷的Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS)黑洞背景上，研究了具有Born-Infeld (BI)电动力学的探针全息超导体的基态(GS)和两个最低激发态(ES1, ES2)。用于调节边界理论的小-大黑洞(SBH/LBH)相变需要电荷Q：中性Schwarzschild-AdS度规对任何M,L^2>0只允许一个正视界，无法支持这种相变。在正确识别的RN-AdS几何上，我们建立了标量/BI规范探测扇区，将凝聚起始的线性本征值问题公式化并用打靶法求解。我们在三个代表性压强(P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c)和五个BI参数b∈{0,1,2,3,5}Q^-1下得到了GS、ES1、ES2的临界温度T_c。T_c随P单调增加，且对于所有三个态都受到b的抑制，对激发态的抑制更强（在b=5 Q^-1时，GS约2%，而ES1/ES2约10-27%）。对b的更精细扫描显示抑制遵循二次规律T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2，其中alpha(GS)~7.4e-4，alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3，alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2，这与阈值模式的径向轮廓一致：基态模式集中在视界附近，而节状激发态模式延伸到更远的体区域。我们将其呈现为节点敏感性图像而非已证实的机制，并通过显式的领头阶BI修正到体规范场使其具体化：非线性电动力学与激发凝聚节点结构之间的这种微分耦合此前未被独立分离和量化，而反作用问题留给后续研究。这些结果阐明了BI非线性如何与激发态的节点结构相互作用，为有反作用的有限温度全息超导体提供了更清晰的线性基线。
classification.one_liner: 在RN-AdS背景上研究Born-Infeld电动力学对激发全息超导体临界温度的抑制，发现激发态对BI参数更敏感且遵循二次标度律。

2604.14492v2.title: Spinning States and Unitarity in 3D Gravity
2604.14492v2.abstract: We revisit the proposal to cure the negative density of states in the three-dimensional gravitational path integral by adding spinning states whose spin scales with the central charge. We show that sub-extremal and extremal spinning states below the black hole threshold, together with certain overspinning states above it, can cancel the known negativities in the spectrum. We interpret the states below threshold as bulk spinning defects. The overspinning states were previously interpreted as classical spinning strings; here we instead study their realization as maximal, fixed-point-free BTZ quotients. All of these spinning geometries exhibit causal pathologies in their Lorentzian continuations. The overspinning geometries arise from mixed elliptic--hyperbolic identifications and possess one formally real chiral temperature. We derive the extremal scalar correlator and propose a quotient-motivated image expression for the overspinning background.

classification.title_zh: 三维引力中的自旋态与幺正性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了通过加入自旋随中心荷标度的自旋态来修复三维引力路径积分中负态密度这一提议。我们证明，黑洞阈值以下的次极值与极值自旋态，以及阈值以上的某些过旋态，可以抵消谱中已知的负性。我们将阈值以下的态解释为体自旋缺陷。过旋态此前被解释为经典自旋弦；在本文中，我们改为研究它们作为极大、无不动点的BTZ商空间的实现。所有这些自旋几何在其洛伦兹延拓中都表现出因果病态。过旋几何来自混合椭圆-双曲识别，并具有一个形式上实的左手温度。我们导出了极值标量关联函数，并为过旋背景提出了一个受商空间启发的镜像表达式。
classification.one_liner: 通过加入自旋随中心荷标度的自旋态，研究三维引力路径积分中负态密度的消除及其BTZ商实现。

2605.26829v2.title: On the Maldacena-Shenker-Stanford chaos bound in black hole spacetimes: Saturation, apparent violations, and their geometric origin
2605.26829v2.abstract: Reported violations of the Maldacena-Shenker-Stanford (MSS) chaos bound in black hole spacetimes raise the question of whether they reflect a genuine breakdown, a feature of particular geometries, or a limitation of the probe used to test the bound. We show that the violations are apparent and arise predominantly in the near-extremal regime, where the black hole develops an $AdS_2\times S^2$ throat, the surface gravity becomes parametrically small, while the Lyapunov exponent of an orbit separated from the throat remains nonzero. We establish a geometric criterion governing this behavior and demonstrate its resolution in two complementary ways: a charged-particle construction that localizes an otherwise excluded orbit within the throat and restores exact saturation, and an out-of-time-order correlator (OTOC) calculation in the Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) throat, which identifies the near-horizon Lyapunov scale and shows why the photon-sphere exponent does not reproduce it when the orbit remains outside the throat. We illustrate the criterion for static and rotating black holes in Einstein, scalar-tensor, and higher-curvature gravity, representative of a broader class of geometries to which it applies. In the absence of external effects that displace the relevant trajectories from the throat, the MSS bound remains respected; the apparent violations instead reflect a geometric decoupling between the probe and the near-horizon region.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞时空中的Maldacena-Shenker-Stanford混沌界：饱和、表观违反及其几何起源
classification.abstract_zh: 关于黑洞时空中Maldacena-Shenker-Stanford（MSS）混沌界被违反的报道引发了一个问题：这些违反反映的是真正的破坏、特定几何的特征，还是用于检验该界的探针的局限性。我们表明，这些违反是表观的，主要出现在近极端区域，在那里黑洞发展出AdS2×S2喉部，表面引力变得参数性地小，而与喉部分离的轨道的Lyapunov指数保持非零。我们建立了控制该行为的几何判据，并展示了其两种互补的解决方式：一种带电粒子构造，将原本被排除的轨道定位在喉部内并恢复精确饱和；以及Jackiw-Teitelboim（JT）喉部中的out-of-time-order关联器（OTOC）计算，它识别了近视界Lyapunov标度，并解释了当轨道保持在喉部之外时，光子球指数为何不能复现它。我们针对爱因斯坦、标量-张量和更高曲率引力中的静态和旋转黑洞说明了该判据，代表了其适用的一类更广泛的几何。在没有将相关轨迹从喉部移开的外部效应的情况下，MSS界仍然得到尊重；表观违反反而反映了探针与近视界区域之间的几何解耦。
classification.one_liner: 证明黑洞中MSS混沌界的表观违反源于近极端AdS2喉部与外部轨道几何解耦，并通过带电粒子及JT喉部OTOC恢复精确饱和。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接涉及全息/黑洞物理中MSS混沌界，通过AdS2喉部和JT OTOC计算解决表观违反，属于全息量子引力和混沌研究的前沿。

2607.27327v3.title: On quantum corrections to semiclassical strings on $\mathrm{AdS}_5\times S^5/\mathbb{Z}_{L}$ orbifold backgrounds
2607.27327v3.abstract: We consider three families of semiclassical string solutions on AdS$_5\times S^5/\mathbb{Z}_L$ orbifold backgrounds which correspond to `twisted' single-trace operators in the SU$(2)$, SU$(3)$ and SL$(2)$ sectors, respectively, of the dual 4d $\mathcal{N}=2$ quiver gauge theory. The leading quantum correction to the classical energy of each solution is computed, and is matched, despite the lack of maximal supersymmetry, to the corresponding results from finite-size corrections to the twisted Bethe ansatz in the continuum $J\to\infty$ limit and the associated Landau-Lifshitz low-energy effective theory. The $\mathbb{Z}_L$ quotient allows the string to have fractional winding branches $\mu=\widetilde{m}+\frac{n}{L}$ along orbifolded directions. As such, stability is a property of the full winding branch $\mu$, rather than of the individual twisted sectors $n$. Restricting to the purely fractional branch ($\widetilde m=0$), we obtain new stable configurations which were absent in the analogous semiclassical string solutions on AdS$_5\times S^5$. The energies of these stable states connect smoothly to those of states in relevant BPS sectors as $\mu\to0$.

classification.title_zh: 关于 AdS5×S5/Z_L 轨道形背景下半经典弦的量子修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑 AdS5×S5/Z_L 轨道形背景上的三族半经典弦解，它们分别对应对偶 4d N=2 箭图规范理论中 SU(2)、SU(3) 和 SL(2) 扇区的“扭曲”单迹算符。计算了每个解经典能量的领头量子修正，尽管缺乏最大超对称，仍将其与连续 J→∞ 极限下扭曲 Bethe ansatz 的有限尺寸修正及相应 Landau-Lifshitz 低能有效理论的结果相匹配。Z_L 商允许弦在轨道形方向具有分数卷绕分支 μ=m~+n/L。因此，稳定性是整个卷绕分支 μ 的性质，而不是各个扭曲扇区 n 的性质。限制在纯分数分支（m~=0），我们获得了在 AdS5×S5 上类似半经典弦解中不存在的新稳定构型。当 μ→0 时，这些稳定态的能量平滑连接到相关 BPS 扇区中态的能量。
classification.one_liner: 计算 AdS5×S5/Z_L 轨道形背景下三族半经典弦解的领头量子修正，并与扭曲 Bethe ansatz 有限尺寸修正匹配，发现纯分数卷绕分支上的新稳定构型。

2608.01349v2.title: Exact Finite-$N$ eRS Surface-Defect Indices and Giant-Graviton Corrections in $\mathcal N=4$ SYM
2608.01349v2.abstract: We compute the exact finite-\(N\) superconformal index of four-dimensional \(\mathcal N=4\) \(U(N)\) Yang--Mills theory with antisymmetric elliptic Ruijsenaars--Schneider (eRS) surface-defect insertions. By matching the inserted eRS Hamiltonians to their independent realization in five-dimensional \(\mathcal N=1^*\) gauge theory, we interpret that the solvable locus \(t=q\) corresponds to vanishing adjoint mass. Motivated by this massless specialization, we impose the four-dimensional balancing condition \(p=uv\). At this point, the eRS operators are conjugate to free \(q\)-shifts, and the self-glued matrix integral reduces to a bilateral free-fermion determinant. This gives closed finite-\(N\) formulas for every antisymmetric rank. On \(v=0\), we determine the stable pure \(u^{kN}\) corrections at all wrapping orders; the bilateral formula also captures the reflected \(v^{kN}\) sectors and mixed \(u\)--\(v\) contributions. We further formulate the balanced perturbation away from \(t=q\) through second order in terms of connected correlators. Finally, a maximal-D3 determinant reproduces the ordinary one-giant coefficient and isolates the microscopic input required for the defect correction.

classification.title_zh: 精确有限N eRS表面缺陷指标与N=4 SYM中的巨引力子修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们计算了带反对称椭圆Ruijsenaars–Schneider（eRS）表面缺陷插入的四维N=4 U(N) Yang-Mills理论的精确有限N超共形指标。通过将插入的eRS哈密顿量与其在五维N=1*规范理论中的独立实现匹配，我们解读出可解轨迹t=q对应于零伴随质量。受此无质量特殊化的启发，我们施加四维平衡条件p=uv。在该点，eRS算子共轭为自由q-平移，自胶合矩阵积分约化为双边自由费米子行列式。这给出了每个反对称秩的闭合有限N公式。在v=0上，我们确定了所有绕数阶的稳定纯u^{kN}修正；双边公式还捕获了反射的v^{kN}扇区和混合u–v贡献。我们进一步将偏离t=q的平衡微扰表述到二阶，用连通关联函数表示。最后，一个极大D3行列式重现了通常的单巨引力子系数，并分离了缺陷修正所需的微观输入。
classification.one_liner: 通过在可解点将eRS表面缺陷约化为自由费米子行列式，给出N=4 U(N) SYM的精确有限N指标和巨引力子修正。

2608.10348v2.title: Holographic Complexity as a Probe of Boundary Entropy in AdS/BCFT
2608.10348v2.abstract: This work establishes a formal bridge between the organizational principles of TQFTs and the AdS/BCFT correspondence, interpreting end of the world EOW branes as physical interfaces carrying boundary-state data. By developing a dictionary that maps cobordism composition to holographic sewing, we show that the Euclidean action and the Ryu and Takayanagi prescription consistently isolate the universal boundary entropy (log g). Applying the Complexity-Action proposal, we demonstrate that a relative renormalization prescription extracts this same universal contribution from the Wheeler and DeWitt action. Finally, we extend the analysis to BTZ black holes, where the late-time complexity growth is shown to encode both the thermal interior dynamics and the universal information of the boundary conditions via the brane tension.

classification.title_zh: 全息复杂度作为AdS/BCFT中边界熵的探针
classification.abstract_zh: 这项工作在TQFT的组织原理与AdS/BCFT对应之间建立了形式上的桥梁，将世界末端（EOW）膜解释为携带边界态数据的物理界面。通过建立将余边复合映射为全息缝合的词典，我们表明欧几里得作用和Ryu-Takayanagi prescription一致地提取出普适边界熵（log g）。应用复杂度-作用量方案，我们证明一种相对重正化处方能从Wheeler-DeWitt作用量中提取同一普适贡献。最后，我们将分析推广到BTZ黑洞，其中晚期复杂度增长通过膜张力同时编码热内部动力学和边界条件的普适信息。
classification.one_liner: 将TQFT与AdS/BCFT联系起来，证明复杂度-作用量方案能从Wheeler-DeWitt作用量中提取边界熵log g，并在BTZ黑洞中通过膜张力编码晚期复杂度增长。

2608.23686v1.title: Color-Kinematics Duality and the Double Copy in Curved Spacetimes
2608.23686v1.abstract: The double copy relates gravitational data to gauge-theory data, most sharply through color-kinematics duality for flat-space scattering amplitudes. This review surveys the extent to which this idea can be formulated beyond asymptotically flat backgrounds. After recalling the flat-space ingredients needed for comparison, we describe curved-space constructions for boundary correlators and scattering observables in AdS, dS, and other non-trivial backgrounds. We then review classical and field-level maps, including Kerr--Schild, Weyl, Cotton, twistor, and convolutional double copies. A separate part is devoted to self-dual sectors. Throughout, we emphasize both the common structures that survive from flat space and the obstructions introduced by curvature.

classification.title_zh: 色-动学对偶与弯曲时空中的双拷贝
classification.abstract_zh: 双拷贝将引力数据与规范理论数据联系起来，最直接地体现在平直时空散射振幅的色-动学对偶中。本综述考察了这一思想在渐近平坦背景之外可推广到何种程度。在回顾了用于比较的平直时空基本要素后，我们描述了AdS、dS及其他非平凡背景中边界关联子与散射观测量的弯曲时空构造。接着回顾了经典和场级映射，包括Kerr-Schild、Weyl、Cotton、twistor和卷积双拷贝。另一部分专门讨论自对偶扇区。我们始终强调平直时空中幸存的结构以及曲率引入的障碍。
classification.one_liner: 综述了双拷贝在弯曲时空（包括AdS和dS）中的推广，涵盖边界关联子、经典映射及自对偶扇区。

2608.23689v1.title: A semiclassical Hilbert space for random matrix theory
2608.23689v1.abstract: We study the one-sided time evolution of thermofield double (TFD) states in random matrix theory, where the Hamiltonian is taken to be a $D\times D$ random matrix drawn from a unitarily invariant emsemble of Hermitian matrices. We argue that the Krylov basis with the maximally entangled state taken as the initial vector gives a semiclassical Hilbert space description of these TFD states in random matrix theory at any $O(1)$ temperature and time in the $D\to \infty$ limit, very analogous to the ``chord Hilbert space'' construction in the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We study this semiclassical description in detail for ensembles where the spectral density in the $D\to \infty$ limit is even, compactly supported on an interval and has square root edges. With a few more conditions on the analytic structure of the spectral density, we observe that the semiclassical Hamiltonian has the same asymptotic behavior at large Krylov depth as that of DSSYK, with the corresponding parameter $\mathfrak{q}=e^{-\lambda}$ being related to the location of the nearest zero of the spectral density away from the spectral cut. Furthermore, in a large class of models corresponding to ultraviolet deformations of the DSSYK spectral density, i.e., where the spectrum in the UV is modified while leaving the near-edge behavior unchanged, we show that the semiclassical effective Hamiltonian in the Krylov basis reduces to the Liouville Hamiltonian of JT gravity in a low-energy, continuum limit. This suggests that our semiclassical Hilbert space should be interpreted as the bulk Hilbert space of a dual gravity description.

classification.title_zh: 随机矩阵理论的半经典希尔伯特空间
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了随机矩阵理论中热场双态（TFD）的单侧时间演化，其中哈密顿量取自由酉不变厄米矩阵系综抽取的 D×D 随机矩阵。我们论证，在 D→∞ 极限下，以最大纠缠态为初始矢量的 Krylov 基在任意 O(1) 温度和时间内为随机矩阵理论中的这些 TFD 态提供了半经典希尔伯特空间描述，这与双尺度 SYK（DSSYK）模型中的“弦希尔伯特空间”构造非常类似。我们详细研究了谱密度在 D→∞ 极限下为偶函数、紧支撑于一个区间且具有平方根边缘的系综。在对谱密度解析结构的若干额外条件下，我们观察到半经典哈密顿量在较大 Krylov 深度处具有与 DSSYK 相同的渐近行为，相应参数 q=e^{-λ} 与谱密度在谱割之外最近零点的位置相关。此外，在一大类对应于 DSSYK 谱密度紫外（UV）变形的模型中，即在 UV 区修改谱而保持近边缘行为不变的模型中，我们证明 Krylov 基中的半经典有效哈密顿量在低能连续极限下约化为 JT 引力的 Liouville 哈密顿量。这表明我们的半经典希尔伯特空间应被解释为对偶引力描述的体（bulk）希尔伯特空间。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Krylov 基为随机矩阵理论中的 TFD 态构造半经典希尔伯特空间，揭示其与 DSSYK 弦希尔伯特空间及低能极限下 JT 引力 Liouville 哈密顿量的联系，暗示对偶引力体描述。
classification.relevance_reason: 本文属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 与随机矩阵理论，未涉及用户关注的任何具体研究支线（全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变/气泡成核、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动）。

2608.23697v1.title: Bremsstrahlung function from Goldstone bosons in AdS$_2$
2608.23697v1.abstract: We study quantum field theory on the AdS$_2$ worldsheet of the fundamental string dual to the half-BPS Wilson line of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills. We consider a recently proposed gauge-fixed string fluctuation Lagrangian around the AdS$_2$ minimal surface, and focus on the nonlinearly realized $SO(6)/SO(5)$ symmetry. The boundary two-point function of the associated tilt operators, whose normalization coefficient is proportional the Bremsstrahlung function, can be related to the bulk two-point function of the broken-symmetry Noether current through the boundary operator expansion. We evaluate the one-loop diagrams contributing to the current correlator, discussing the role of dimensional regularization and recovering the known strong-coupling correction to the Bremsstrahlung function directly from AdS$_2$ worldsheet quantum field theory.

classification.title_zh: 来自 AdS$_2$ 中 Goldstone 玻色子的轫致辐射函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 中半 BPS Wilson 线所对偶的基本弦的 AdS$_2$ 世界面上的量子场论。我们考虑最近提出的围绕 AdS$_2$ 极小曲面的规范固定弦涨落拉格朗日量，并关注非线性实现的 SO(6)/SO(5) 对称性。相关倾斜算符的边界两点函数（其归一化系数正比于轫致辐射函数）可以通过边界算符展开与破缺对称 Noether 流的体两点函数联系起来。我们计算了对流关联函数有贡献的单圈图，讨论了维度正则化的作用，并直接从 AdS$_2$ 世界面量子场论恢复了已知的轫致辐射函数的强耦合修正。
classification.one_liner: 利用 AdS$_2$ 世界面量子场论和 Goldstone 玻色子方法，从破缺对称 Noether 流相关函数计算中恢复了 Wilson 线轫致辐射函数的已知强耦合修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文涉及全息 Wilson 线对应、AdS2 世界面量子场论与对称性破缺，属于 AdS/CFT 字典和强耦合计算方向，但与用户给出的冷凝态、非平衡、D-brane 驱动等重点标签无直接重叠，因此相关性中等。

2608.23709v1.title: Holographic Spread Complexity at Fixed Charge: Routhians, Branes and Strings
2608.23709v1.abstract: Holographic spread (Krylov) complexity relates the growth of a boundary state's complexity to the proper radial momentum of a probe falling into the bulk. Unitary evolution makes spread complexity an even function of time. We show that this requirement fails whenever a probe carries a conserved Noether charge and is described by its unreduced Lagrangian. The cure is simple and universal: passing to the Routhian of the fixed-charge sector restores the correct short-time behaviour of the complexity. We establish this prescription from first principles and test it across an extensive family of probes: charged particles, non-BPS D-branes with detuned tension and charge, branes excited along internal isometries, worldvolume gauge fields, a fluctuating D0-brane in AdS$_4\times \mathbb{CP}^3$ and fundamental strings combining winding with rotation in AdS$_5\times \mathrm{S}^5$ complemented by further examples in AdS$_3\times \mathrm{S}^3\times T^4$, ABJM, and the charged Anabal\'on-Ross background. We then translate these results into Krylov-chain data, extracting Lanczos coefficients and Krylov-number correlators, and propose that complexity for charged, extended probes organises naturally into collective, fluctuation, charge and mixed contributions. This decomposition opens a concrete path toward a genuinely field-theoretic, multi-seed construction of holographic complexity.

classification.title_zh: 固定荷下的全息扩展复杂度：Routhian、膜与弦
classification.abstract_zh: 全息扩展（Krylov）复杂度将边界态复杂度的增长与落入体态的探针的径向动量联系起来。幺正演化使扩展复杂度成为时间的偶函数。我们证明，当探针携带守恒的 Noether 荷并由未约化的拉格朗日量描述时，这一要求会失效。解决办法简单而普遍：转入固定荷扇区的 Routhian，即可恢复复杂度在短时间行为的正确形式。我们从第一性原理确立了这一处理方式，并在大量探针族中加以检验：带电粒子、张力和电荷失谐的非 BPS D-膜、沿内部等距方向激发的膜、世界体积规范场、AdS4×CP3 中的涨落 D0-膜，以及 AdS5×S5 中绕转与转动结合的基本弦；此外还补充了 AdS3×S3×T4、ABJM 和带电荷的 Anabalón-Ross 背景等例子。我们将这些结果转化为 Krylov 链数据，提取 Lanczos 系数和 Krylov 数关联子，并提出带荷、延展探针的复杂度自然地组织为集体贡献、涨落贡献、电荷贡献和混合贡献。这种分解为构建真正场论化、多种子全息复杂度开辟了一条具体路径。
classification.one_liner: 带守恒荷的全息扩展复杂度需用固定荷扇区 Routhian 恢复偶时间行为，并在多种膜/弦探针中验证和映射到 Krylov 链数据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息复杂度与 AdS/CFT 量子信息方向，与用户指定的重点标签（全息超流超导、QNM、相变、D3-D7 探针膜等）无直接重叠，因此相关性低。

2608.24706v1.title: Hagedorn temperature from holography: rotating and charged systems
2608.24706v1.abstract: Using the string/field theory correspondence as a tool, we study the dependence of the Hagedorn temperature of strongly coupled, planar gauge theories on angular velocities and chemical potentials for $U(1)$ global currents. Our results are obtained from an interplay of world-sheet semiclassical quantization methods and target space low energy effective ones. The Hagedorn temperature is given as an expansion in the inverse (large) 't Hooft coupling limit. Working to quadratic order in the fluctuations, the world-sheet analysis provides the leading, the next-to-leading and part of the next-to-next-to leading order terms. In particular, it captures the NNLO $\log 2$ terms which are due to the contributions of non-zero modes to the zero-point energy. These modes are not accounted for by the effective approach, within which they have to be included by hand using suitable educated guesses. On the other hand, the effective methods allow to compute in a relatively easy way the missing NNLO pieces (and even further subleading corrections), which could be accounted for from the world-sheet approach only working at quartic (or higher) order in the fluctuations. We present general results and several examples in various dimensions, including both confining models and conformal field theories on spheres (such as $\mathcal N=4$ SYM and ABJM) dual to string theories on global $AdS$ spaces.

classification.title_zh: 全息得到的Hagedorn温度：旋转和带点系统
classification.abstract_zh: 利用弦论/场论对应作为工具，我们研究了强耦合平面规范理论的Hagedorn温度对角速度和U(1)整体流化学势的依赖。我们的结果来源于世界面半经典量子化方法与靶空间低能有效方法的相互作用。Hagedorn温度以逆（大）'t Hooft耦合极限的展开形式给出。在涨落的二次阶近似下，世界面分析提供了领头阶、次领头阶以及部分次次领头阶项。特别地，它捕获了由于非零模式对零点能的贡献而产生的NNLO log2项。这些模式不被有效方法所考虑，在有效方法中必须通过适当的经验猜测手动加入。另一方面，有效方法允许相对容易地计算缺失的NNLO部分（甚至进一步的次领头修正），这些修正只有通过在世界面方法中处理涨落的四次（或更高）阶才能得到。我们给出了普遍结果以及不同维度下的几个例子，包括限制模型和球面上的共形场论（如N=4 SYM和ABJM），它们对偶于全局AdS空间上的弦论。
classification.one_liner: 通过全息对应研究旋转和带电荷的强耦合规范理论的Hagedorn温度，结合世界面与有效方法给出高阶修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接使用全息对应（弦论/场论对应）研究强耦合规范理论的Hagedorn温度，属于AdS/CFT基础字典范畴。

2601.08809v4.title: Strong coupling expansion of $1\over 2$ BPS Wilson loop in SYM theory and 2-loop Green-Schwarz string in AdS$_5 \times $S$^5$
2601.08809v4.abstract: The exact localization result for the expectation value of the $1\over 2$ BPS circular Wilson loop in ${\cal N}=4$ SYM theory is given in the planar limit by the famous Bessel function expression: $\langle W\rangle = {2N\over \sqrt \lambda } I_1 ( \sqrt \lambda)$. Expanded in large $\lambda$ and expressed in terms of the AdS$_5 \times $S$^5$ string tension $T= {\sqrt \lambda \over 2\pi}$ this gives $\langle W\rangle = {\sqrt T\over 2\pi g_s} e^{2\pi T} (1- {3\over 16 \pi} T^{-1} + ...)$.The exponential is matched by the value of the action of the string with the AdS$_2$ world volume while the prefactor comes from the 1-loop GS string correction. Here we address the question of how the subleading $T^{-1}$ term could be reproduced by the 2-loop correction in the corresponding partition function of the AdS$_5 \times $S$^5$ GS string expanded near the AdS$_2$ minimal surface. We find that the string correction contains a non-zero UV logarithmic divergence implying that comparison with the SYM result requires a particular subtraction prescription. We discuss implications of this conclusion for checking the AdS/CFT duality at strong coupling.

classification.title_zh: SYM 理论中 1/2 BPS 威尔逊圈的强耦合展开与 AdS$_5\times$S$^5$ 中 2 圈 Green-Schwarz 弦
classification.abstract_zh: 在平面极限下，${\cal N}=4$ SYM 理论中 $1\over 2$ BPS 圆形威尔逊圈期望值的精确局域化结果由著名的贝塞尔函数表达式给出：$\langle W\rangle = {2N\over \sqrt \lambda } I_1 ( \sqrt \lambda)$。按大 $\lambda$ 展开并用 AdS$_5 \times$S$^5$ 弦张力 $T= {\sqrt \lambda \over 2\pi}$ 表示，可得 $\langle W\rangle = {\sqrt T\over 2\pi g_s} e^{2\pi T} (1- {3\over 16 \pi} T^{-1} + ...)$。指数部分由 AdS$_2$ 世界体积弦的作用量匹配，而前因子来自 1 圈 GS 弦修正。本文探讨如何由在 AdS$_2$ 极值曲面附近展开的 AdS$_5 \times$S$^5$ GS 弦配分函数的 2 圈修正来重现次领头 $T^{-1}$ 项。我们发现弦修正包含非零紫外对数发散，这意味着与 SYM 结果的比较需要特定减除方案。我们讨论了这一结论对在强耦合下检验 AdS/CFT 对偶的含义。
classification.one_liner: 研究 1/2 BPS 威尔逊圈强耦合展开中 T^{-1} 项的 2 圈弦修正，发现紫外对数发散并讨论减除方案。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接检验 AdS/CFT 强耦合下的 Wilson loop 对应，属于全息字典与弦 sigma 模型微扰计算。

2602.05750v3.title: The 2-Dimensional Dual of $\phi^4$ in AdS$_3$
2602.05750v3.abstract: We study the correlation functions of a conformally coupled $\phi^4$-interacting theory in AdS$_3$ and its dual CFT$_2$. The one-loop diagram is not expressible in terms of known transcendental functions, but is shown to be expressible as an infinite sum of previously well-studied tree-level diagrams, and we compute this sum using several number-theoretic conjectures. This enables us to extract recursively, the analytic expressions of anomalous dimensions of all dual double-trace operators. In the $s$-channel various consistency checks were performed against established bootstrap method, while our results in the $t$- and $u$-channel are not available in any previous literature to our knowledge.

classification.title_zh: AdS₃ 中 φ⁴ 理论的二维对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了 AdS₃ 中共形耦合的 φ⁴ 相互作用理论及其对偶 CFT₂ 的关联函数。单圈图不能用已知超越函数表示，但可表示为先前已充分研究的树级图的无穷和，我们利用若干数论猜想计算了该和。这使我们能够递归地提取所有对偶双迹算符反常维数的解析表达式。在 s 通道中，我们与既有的 bootstrap 方法进行了一致性检验，而 t 通道和 u 通道的结果据我们所知在以往文献中尚未出现。
classification.one_liner: 通过将单圈图展开为树级图无穷和，计算 AdS₃ 中 φ⁴ 理论对偶 CFT₂ 中双迹算符的反常维数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接计算 AdS₃/CFT₂ 对偶中双迹算符的反常维数，属于 multi-trace 算子与全息字典的核心内容，与用户的 multi-trace 支线高度相关。

2603.18138v3.title: The Resolved Elliptic Genus and the D1-D5 CFT
2603.18138v3.abstract: This paper is a follow-up to the short paper arXiv:2509.19425, greatly expanding the discussion with examples and providing derivations and justifications of results presented there. We introduce a new supersymmetry index for the D1-D5 CFT on $T^4$, which we call the resolved elliptic genus (REG). It is a one-parameter generalisation of the standard supersymmetry index, the modified elliptic genus (MEG), and arises naturally in the free symmetric orbifold description of the theory within a new formalism, based on Schur-Weyl duality, that we develop. In this formalism, the Hilbert space of the symmetric orbifold CFT is decomposed into symmetry sectors in which the structure of the states contributing to the MEG is transparent. By examining the action of the supercharge deformed by an exactly marginal operator on the relevant symmetry algebra, we propose a superselection rule governing the lifting process of BPS states, and use it to construct the REG by summing only over those symmetry sectors that can mix according to this rule. The REG exhibits detailed agreement between the CFT and supergravity below the black-hole threshold, a regime in which the MEG is essentially trivial. Above the threshold, the REG is dominated by black-hole microstates, which are now distributed amongst distinct sectors that are invisible to the MEG. We expect both the new formalism and the REG to provide useful new tools for studying the structure of black-hole microstates. In particular, we comment on their possible relevance to the fortuity program for understanding black-hole microstates within CFT.

classification.title_zh: 解析椭圆亏格与D1-D5 CFT
classification.abstract_zh: 本文是对短文arXiv:2509.19425的后续，大幅扩展了讨论并提供了结果推导与验证。我们为T^4上的D1-D5 CFT引入了一个新的超对称指标，称之为解析椭圆亏格（REG）。它是标准超对称指标——修正椭圆亏格（MEG）的单参数推广，并在我们基于Schur-Weyl对偶发展的新形式论中自然出现于自由对称轨道描述。在该形式论中，对称轨道CFT的希尔伯特空间被分解为对称性扇区，其中对MEG有贡献的态结构清晰可见。通过考察由恰好边缘算子形变的超荷在相关对称代数上的作用，我们提出了一个控制BPS态提升过程的超选择规则，并据此仅对那些根据此规则可以混合的对称性扇区求和来构造REG。REG在黑洞阈值以下表现出CFT与超引力之间的细致一致性，而在此区间MEG基本平凡。在阈值以上，REG由黑洞微观态主导，这些微观态分布在MEG不可见的多个不同扇区中。我们预期新形式论和REG能为研究黑洞微观结构提供有用的新工具。特别地，我们评论了它们与理解CFT内黑洞微观态的fortuity项目的可能关联。
classification.one_liner: 提出D1-D5 CFT的新型超对称指标“解析椭圆亏格”，用于区分黑洞微观态。

2604.16109v2.title: Constrained Pad\'e Ensembles for Thermal $\mathcal{N}{=}4$ SYM with the Exact $\mathcal O(\lambda^{5/2})$ Coefficient
2604.16109v2.abstract: We revisit the constrained log-subtracted two-point Pad\'e (LSTP) ensemble for thermal $\mathcal{N}=4$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills (SYM) thermodynamics in four spacetime dimensions after upgrading the weak-coupling truncation from $\mathcal{O}(\lambda^2)$ to the exact $\mathcal{O}(\lambda^{5/2})$ coefficient. We keep the LSTP interpolation ansatz unchanged and shift the weak-side matching points to the regime where the new term is numerically significant. Within the same parameter scan the admissible set collapses from $9$ nominal survivors ($3$ distinct curves) to a single distinct curve, the crossover range shrinks to a unique value, and the pointwise band width drops to zero within numerical resolution. The Hermite-Pad\'e (HP) central curve does not coincide with the unique LSTP survivor, so the updated weak-side matching removes the LSTP scan uncertainty but not the difference between the two routes. The minimal HP extension that also carries the exact coefficient is uniquely determined and develops a spurious pole-zero pair at small coupling. Away from that pair the HP and LSTP curves still differ, so this difference persists at the same weak-coupling order.

classification.title_zh: 带精确 O(λ^{5/2}) 系数的热 N=4 SYM 约束 Padé 系综
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在将弱耦合截断从 O(λ²) 升级到精确的 O(λ^{5/2}) 系数后，重新考察了四维热 N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯(SYM)热力学的约束对数扣除两点 Padé(LSTP)系综。我们保持 LSTP 插值 ansatz 不变，并将弱侧匹配点移动到新项数值显著的区间。在同一参数扫描下，可容许集合从 9 个名义幸存者（3 条不同曲线）缩减为单一不同曲线，交叉区间缩为唯一值，逐点带宽在数值精度内降至零。Hermite-Padé(HP)中心曲线与唯一 LSTP 幸存者不一致，因此更新后的弱侧匹配消除了 LSTP 扫描不确定性，但并未消除两条路径之间的差异。带有精确系数的最小 HP 扩展是唯一确定的，并在小耦合处出现一个假极点-零点对。在该对之外，HP 与 LSTP 曲线仍然不同，因此该差异在相同的弱耦合阶数下持续存在。
classification.one_liner: 利用精确的 O(λ^{5/2}) 弱耦合系数更新约束两点 Padé 系综，使 N=4 SYM 热力学插值的扫描不确定性消失，并比较了 LSTP 与 Hermite-Padé 两条途径。

2605.20294v2.title: Topology sums, sectorwise holography, and horizon normalcy
2605.20294v2.abstract: The ``holography of information'' (HoI) principle argues that gravity can encode information redundantly in asymptotic observables. Although HoI is ultimately a nonperturbative claim, its standard motivation uses semiclassical gravitational constraints, the boundary nature of the Hamiltonian, and vacuum-sector cyclicity. We ask what happens when the same semiclassical path-integral reasoning allows topology sums that generate baby-universe or $\alpha$-sector data. Our analysis is conditional: such sectors need not survive in every unitary completion, and the Baby Universe Hypothesis of McNamara and Vafa instead suggests $\dim\mathcal H_{\rm BU}=1$ in consistent $d>3$ quantum gravity. If $\mathcal H_{\rm BU}$ is nontrivial, as in the Marolf--Maxfield formulation and in ensemble-like examples such as JT gravity, then HoI is naturally refined to an $\alpha$-sectorwise statement, $\overline{\mathcal A_\infty^{(\alpha)}|0_\alpha\rangle}=\mathcal H_\alpha$, rather than completeness on the full topology-summed Hilbert space. In a fixed $\alpha$-sector, HoI may obstruct AMPS factorization and allow a smooth horizon; in an unconditioned topology-summed state, the sector-independent obstruction is not automatic. A Bell-pair diagnostic shows that a sector-independent smooth interior requires aligned interior reconstructions, or access to the sector label. Thus the HoI-based absence of firewalls becomes conditional on global sector data, in tension with the generally covariant expectation emphasized by Bousso that horizon normalcy should be determined by local semiclassical geometry. If the exact theory collapses $\mathcal H_{\rm BU}$ to one dimension, the obstruction discussed here is absent.

classification.title_zh: 拓扑求和、扇区化全息与视界正常性
classification.abstract_zh: “信息全息性”（HoI）原理认为引力可以在渐近观测量中冗余编码信息。尽管 HoI 最终是非微扰主张，其标准动机使用半经典引力约束、哈密顿量的边界性质以及真空扇区的循环性。我们考虑当相同的半经典路径积分论证允许产生婴宇宙或 α-扇区数据的拓扑求和时会发生什么。我们的分析是有条件的：这些扇区不一定在每个幺正完备化中都存在，而 McNamara 和 Vafa 的婴宇宙假设反而表明在一致的 d>3 量子引力中 dim H_BU=1。如果 H_BU 非平凡，如 Marolf–Maxfield 构造和 JT 引力等系综示例，那么 HoI 自然被精炼为 α-扇区级陈述，\overline{\mathcal A_\infty^{(\alpha)}|0_\alpha\rangle}=\mathcal H_\alpha，而不是整个拓扑求和希尔伯特空间上的完备性。在固定 α-扇区中，HoI 可能阻碍 AMPS 分解并允许光滑视界；在无条件拓扑求和态中，扇区无关的阻碍并非自动成立。Bell 对诊断表明，扇区无关的光滑内部需要内部重构对齐，或获得扇区标签。因此，基于 HoI 的无火墙论点变得依赖于全局扇区数据，这与 Bousso 强调的一般协变期望（视界正常性应由局域半经典几何决定）存在张力。如果精确理论将 H_BU 坍缩为一维，这里讨论的阻碍不存在。
classification.one_liner: 探讨信息全息原理在拓扑求和和婴宇宙 α-扇区下的修正，指出光滑视界依赖于全局扇区数据，与局域半经典协变期望存在张力。

2606.00488v2.title: Massless Islands in Wedge Holography
2606.00488v2.abstract: Entanglement islands are most easily realized in doubly holographic models with massive gravitons or non-gravitating baths. In wedge holography, however, Neumann boundary conditions on both branes give a normalizable massless graviton, while the island saddle of the purely geometric Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) problem collapses to the horizon. Negative Dvali--Gabadadze--Porrati (DGP) terms can restore nontrivial islands by modifying the endpoint condition, but this branch contains a massive ghost. We propose a different semiclassical mechanism. We keep the wedge gravitational action free of DGP terms and couple the healthy Neumann wedge sector to a unitary defect CFT localized at the codimension-two corner. This sector is distinct from the standard corner CFT dual to the undeformed wedge, so its entropy enters as the ordinary matter-entropy term in the quantum extremal surface (QES) prescription without double counting the wedge RT area. If the defect theory is holographic, this entropy can be evaluated by an auxiliary RT surface. We show that when the wedge endpoint determines the defect entangling region, the auxiliary area can vary in the opposite way to the wedge area while all couplings and central charges remain positive. A local endpoint model gives an isolated stable saddle that dominates over the Hartman--Maldacena (HM) surface at late times. The QES condition then replaces the pure orthogonality condition and permits a non-horizon island saddle in a long-range, massless, ghost-free gravitational theory. Thus, the obstruction to massless islands in minimal wedge holography is not masslessness itself, but the absence of a healthy matter-entropy contribution capable of balancing the horizon-minimizing area variation.

classification.title_zh: 楔形全息中的无质量岛
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠岛最容易在具有有质量引力子或非引力化浴槽的双重全息模型中实现。然而在楔形全息中，两个膜上的 Neumann 边界条件给出一个可归一化的无质量引力子，而纯几何 Ryu–Takayanagi (RT) 问题的岛鞍点塌缩到视界。负 Dvali–Gabadadze–Porrati (DGP) 项可以通过修改端点条件恢复非平凡岛，但该分支包含一个有质量鬼场。我们提出一种不同的半经典机制。我们保持楔形引力作用量不含 DGP 项，并将健康的 Neumann 楔形扇区与位于余二维角落处的幺正缺陷 CFT 耦合。该扇区不同于未变形楔形对应的标准角 CFT，因此其熵作为量子极值面 (QES) 处方中的普通物质熵项进入，而不会与楔形 RT 面积重复计算。如果缺陷理论是全息的，则这个熵可以由一个辅助 RT 面来评估。我们证明，当楔形端点决定缺陷纠缠区域时，辅助面积可以与楔形面积相反的方式变化，同时所有耦合和中心荷保持为正。一个局域端点模型给出一个孤立的稳定鞍点，在晚期超过哈特曼–马尔达塞纳 (HM) 面。QES 条件从而取代纯正交条件，并允许在一个长程、无质量、无鬼场的引力理论中出现非视界岛鞍点。因此，最小楔形全息中无质量岛的障碍并不是无质量本身，而是缺少能够平衡视界最小化面积变化的健康物质熵贡献。
classification.one_liner: 提出在楔形全息中通过余二维角落缺陷 CFT 恢复无质量、无鬼场的非平凡纠缠岛，指出障碍在于缺少可平衡面积变化的物质熵贡献。

2606.31724v2.title: Holographic Krylov Complexity with Lifshitz Scaling and Hyperscaling Violation
2606.31724v2.abstract: Following the holographic proposal that identifies the growth rate of Krylov complexity with the proper radial momentum of an infalling massive probe, we study Krylov complexity in Lifshitz and hyperscaling-violating backgrounds. For pure Lifshitz geometries, we find quadratic complexity growth for all values of the dynamical exponent. For hyperscaling-violating backgrounds, we show that the hyperscaling-violating exponent directly controls the late-time growth exponent, with a special limiting case exhibiting oscillatory behavior with a logarithmic envelope. We also extend our analysis to top-down string constructions, confirming the robustness of the scaling behaviors obtained in the bottom-up approach. Our analysis establishes that the momentum-Krylov correspondence extends naturally to non-relativistic holographic settings and remains well-defined despite the causal pathologies of Lifshitz spacetimes.

classification.title_zh: 具有Lifshitz标度和超尺度破坏的全息Krylov复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 遵循将Krylov复杂度的增长率与下落的巨大探针的径向动量等同的全息提议，我们在Lifshitz和超尺度破坏背景下研究Krylov复杂度。对于纯Lifshitz几何，我们发现所有动力学指数值下复杂度均呈二次增长。对于超尺度破坏背景，我们证明超尺度破坏指数直接控制晚期时间增长指数，其中一种特殊极限情形表现出带对数包络的振荡行为。我们还将分析扩展到自上而下的弦论构造，证实了自下而上方法中获得的标度行为的稳健性。我们的分析表明，动量-克雷洛夫对应关系自然地推广到非相对论全息环境，并且尽管Lifshitz时空具有因果病态，该对应关系仍然定义良好。

2607.03800v4.title: A Horizon-to-Boundary Dictionary Linking Smooth Horizon Continuation, Pole-Skipping, and \(SL(2,\mathbb R)\) Lowest-Weight Structure
2607.03800v4.abstract: We study pole-skipping for a scalar field in the JT/AdS$_2$ black-hole background. Previous work established the local mechanism: at a pole-skipping point, a near-horizon recurrence relation becomes degenerate and an additional regular expansion coefficient is left undetermined. We take this local degeneracy as the starting point and track two independent solutions normalized at the AdS boundary, denoted by $R_1$ and $R_2$ for the source and response branches, respectively. Let $\widehat A$ and $\widehat B$ denote the source and response coefficients after their common singular factor is removed, and let $\chi_\mu$ denote the universal ingoing horizon factor. We find \[ \widehat A=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_2}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty, \qquad \widehat B=0 \Longleftrightarrow \frac{R_1}{\chi_\mu}\in C^\infty . \] Thus the source and response zeros correspond separately to horizon smoothness of the two boundary-normalized solutions after the ingoing factor is removed. At integer resonance the local regular solution contains an additional coefficient $a_N$. In the JT/AdS$_2$ model, continuation of the nonresonant ingoing solution fixes $a_N=0$ and thereby selects a unique retarded value at resonance, although unrestricted approaches in parameter space remain path dependent. At the endpoint of the pole-skipping lattice, the response branch is a lowest-weight state of the background $SL(2,\mathbb R)$ symmetry. A static holographic-superconductor example further shows that simultaneous horizon smoothness is insufficient if the two boundary branches are linearly dependent. A two-branch pole-zero intersection therefore requires \[ W[R_1,R_2]\neq0. \] These results distinguish the known local horizon degeneracy from the global relation between boundary branches and the resonant horizon solution space.

classification.title_zh: 连接光滑视界延拓、极点跳跃与SL(2,R)最低权结构的视界-边界字典
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究JT/AdS2黑洞背景中标量场的pole-skipping。此前工作确立了局域机制：在pole-skipping点，近视界递推关系变得退化，留下一个额外的正则展开系数未定。我们以这一局域退化作为出发点，追踪在AdS边界归一化的两个独立解，分别记为源分支与响应分支的R1和R2。令\widehat A和\widehat B表示去除共同奇异因子后的源与响应系数，\chi_\mu表示普适的内行视界因子。我们发现：\widehat A=0当且仅当R2/\chi_\mu属于C^\infty；\widehat B=0当且仅当R1/\chi_\mu属于C^\infty。因此源与响应零点分别对应两个边界归一化解在去除内行因子后的视界光滑性。在整数共振处，局域正则解包含额外系数a_N。在JT/AdS2模型中，非共振内行解的延拓固定a_N=0，从而在共振处选出唯一的滞后值，尽管参数空间中的无限制途径仍存在路径依赖。在pole-skipping格点端点，响应分支是背景SL(2,R)对称性的最低权态。一个静态全息超导例子进一步表明，若两个边界分支线性相关，则同时视界光滑并不充分。因此双分支极点-零点相交要求W[R1,R2]不等于0。这些结果区分了已知的局域视界退化与边界分支和共振视界解空间之间的全局关系。

2608.12850v2.title: D4-branes wrapped on topological disks from matter-coupled F(4) gauged supergravity
2608.12850v2.abstract: We study a number of supersymmetric $AdS_4\times \Sigma$ solutions with $\Sigma$ being a topological disk with non-trivial $U(1)$ holonomy on the boundary or a ``half-spindle'' from matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity. The gauged supergravity is coupled to three vector multiplets with $SO(3)\times SO(3)$ gauge group. The resulting solutions preserve eight supercharges and $SO(2)\times SO(2)$ or $SO(2)_{\text{diag}}$ symmetries and are expected to be dual to $N=2$ SCFTs in three dimensions arising from compactifications of five-dimensional $N=2$ SCFT on a half-spindle. All of the solutions lie within the $U(1)\times U(1)$ subsector of the matter-coupled $F(4)$ gauged supergravity that can be embedded in massive type IIA theory. After uplifted to ten dimensions, the solutions can be interpreted as a system of D4-D8-branes wrapped on $\Sigma$. Some of the solutions are asymptotic to a locally $AdS_6$ geometry and can be identified as codimension-2 conformal defects within the $N=2$ SCFT in five dimensions. For these solutions, the circle inside $\Sigma$ decompactifies in the $AdS_6$ limit rendering the holographic free energy infinite. There also exist solutions with finite free energy in the dual three-dimensional SCFTs. In addition, we show that the results both extend the previously known solutions and provide a novel class of solutions.

classification.title_zh: 物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力中缠绕在拓扑圆盘上的 D4-膜
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力中的若干超对称 AdS4×Sigma 解，其中 Sigma 是边界上具有非平凡 U(1) 和乐（holonomy）的拓扑圆盘或“半纺锤体”（half-spindle）。该规范超引力耦合了三个矢量多重态，规范群为 SO(3)×SO(3)。所得解保持八个超荷，并具有 SO(2)×SO(2) 或 SO(2)_diag 对称性，预期对偶于由五维 N=2 SCFT 在半纺锤体上紧致化得到的三维 N=2 SCFT。所有这些解都位于物质耦合 F(4) 规范超引力的 U(1)×U(1) 子扇区中，并可嵌入 massive type IIA 超引力。提升到十维后，这些解可解释为 D4-D8 膜系统缠绕在 Sigma 上。其中一些解渐近于局部 AdS6 几何，可视为五维 N=2 SCFT 内的余维-2 共形缺陷。对这些解，Sigma 内的圆在 AdS6 极限下退紧致化，导致全息自由能发散。也存在在三维 SCFT 中具有有限自由能的解。此外，我们表明这些结果既推广了先前已知的解，也提供了一类新解。
classification.one_liner: 构造了 F(4) 规范超引力中 AdS4×拓扑圆盘/半纺锤体的超对称解，对应 D4-D8 膜缠绕系统，并论证其全息对偶为三维 N=2 SCFT 或五维 SCFT 中的共形缺陷。

2608.16982v2.title: A geodesic distance interpretation of Lanczos coefficients
2608.16982v2.abstract: We study the spread complexity of the infinite-temperature thermofield double state in large-$N$ random matrix theory and investigate the physical meaning of its Lanczos coefficients $b_n$. The leading density of states defines a family of orthogonal polynomials whose recursion coefficients coincide with the Lanczos coefficients of the associated Krylov dynamics. Starting from the Coulomb-gas equation, we derive a pair of nonlinear relations for these coefficients, which we call the Lanczos equations. Since the Lanczos coefficients approach constants at large Krylov index, the spread complexity grows linearly at late times. We further show that the Lanczos coefficients can be interpreted as generating functions for planar maps. For an even potential, the difference $b_{n+1}^2-b_n^2$ generates maps with two legs whose marked legs are separated by the exact geodesic distance $n$. Consequently, the spread complexity acceleration operator equals twice the geodesic generating operator. We illustrate these results in the quartic matrix model, where the expansion in the quartic coupling counts tetravalent planar maps, and in the double-scaled Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model, where the auxiliary Hilbert space can be identified with the physical chord Hilbert space.

classification.title_zh: Lanczos 系数的测地线距离诠释
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究大 N 随机矩阵理论中无限温度热场双态（TFD）的展开复杂度，并探讨其 Lanczos 系数 b_n 的物理意义。态密度的领头阶定义了一族正交多项式，其递推系数与相应 Krylov 动力学的 Lanczos 系数一致。从库仑气体方程出发，我们导出一组关于这些系数的非线性关系，称为 Lanczos 方程。由于 Lanczos 系数在大 Krylov 指标处趋于常数，展开复杂度在晚期线性增长。进一步表明，Lanczos 系数可解释为平面地图的生成函数。对偶势，差值 b_{n+1}^2 - b_n^2 生成带有两条腿的地图，标记腿之间相隔精确的测地距离 n。因此，展开复杂度加速算符等于测地生成算符的两倍。我们在四次矩阵模型中说明了这些结果，其中按四次耦合展开计数四价平面地图；在双标度 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中，辅助希尔伯特空间可与物理弦希尔伯特空间等同。
classification.one_liner: 将 Lanczos 系数解释为平面地图的生成函数，揭示展开复杂度与随机矩阵/SYK 中测地距离的联系。

2608.19310v2.title: Dissipation-enhanced scrambling in the SYK model coupled to a lossy cavity
2608.19310v2.abstract: We study the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, a disordered model of $N$ Majorana fermions and $R=\gamma N$ bosons in which the bosons are linearly coupled to independent realizations of SYK $p$-body interactions, in the presence of dissipation, modeled by a Lindblad master equation. Motivated by recent proposals for implementing SYK models in quantum simulators, we focus on bosonic leakage at rate $\kappa$. Initializing the system in the steady state, we analyze the late-time fermionic relaxation rate and the Lyapunov exponent, solving the large-$N$ theory both numerically and for $p$ large, finding a rich landscape of dynamical behaviors. Most notably, the Lyapunov exponent remains positive for every value of $\kappa$ and, for $p>2$, can even grow as $\kappa$ increases. The QED case $p=2$, which lies between the fully chaotic regime $p>2$ and the integrable case $p=1$, exhibits special features. We also identify a critical value of the boson-to-fermion ratio $\gamma_c \approx 2/p^2$ separating distinct dynamical regimes.

classification.title_zh: 耦合到耗散腔的SYK模型中的耗散增强量子置乱
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型，这是一个包含 $N$ 个马约拉纳费米子和 $R=\gamma N$ 个玻色子的无序模型，其中玻色子线性耦合到 SYK $p$ 体相互作用的独立实现，并存在由 Lindblad 主方程描述的耗散。受近期在量子模拟器中实现 SYK 模型的提案启发，我们关注玻色子泄漏（速率 $\kappa$）。将系统初始化在稳态，我们分析晚时间费米子弛豫率和 Lyapunov 指数，通过数值和大 $p$ 近似求解大-$N$ 理论，发现丰富的动力学行为景观。最值得注意的是，Lyapunov 指数对每个 $\kappa$ 值保持为正，并且对于 $p>2$，甚至可随 $\kappa$ 增大而增长。QED 情形 $p=2$ 位于完全混沌区域 $p>2$ 与可积情形 $p=1$ 之间，表现出特殊性质。我们还确定了玻色子-费米子比的一个临界值 $\gamma_c \approx 2/p^2$，它区分了不同的动力学区域。

2601.04467v3.title: Holographic codes seen through ZX-calculus
2601.04467v3.abstract: We re-visit the pentagon holographic quantum error correcting code from a ZX-calculus perspective. By expressing the underlying tensors as ZX-diagrams, we study the stabiliser structure of the code via Pauli webs. In addition, we obtain a diagrammatic understanding of its logical operators, encoding isometries, R\'enyi entropy and toy models of black holes/wormholes. Then, motivated by the pentagon holographic code's ZX-diagram, we introduce a family of codes constructed from ZX-diagrams on its dual hyperbolic tessellations and study their logical error rates using belief propagation decoders. Finally, we show how to construct spacetime ZX-diagrams that realise a fault-tolerant quantum channel in which every internal edge is a protected fault location.

classification.title_zh: 通过ZX演算看全息码
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从ZX演算的角度重新审视五边形全息量子纠错码。通过将底层张量表示为ZX图，我们通过泡利网（Pauli webs）研究码的稳定子结构。此外，我们获得了对其逻辑算子、编码等距、Rényi熵以及黑洞/虫洞玩具模型的图解理解。然后，受五边形全息码ZX图的启发，我们引入了一族由其双曲镶嵌上的ZX图构造的码，并使用置信传播解码器研究其逻辑错误率。最后，我们展示了如何构造时空ZX图，以实现一个容错量子信道，其中每条内部边都是一个受保护的故障位置。
classification.one_liner: 利用ZX演算重新表述五边形全息码，并构造一族基于双曲ZX图的全息码与容错量子信道。

2608.24968v1.title: CFT$_3$ Realizations and Celestial Representation Theory of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ Algebra
2608.24968v1.abstract: We study CFT$_3$ realizations and celestial representations of the $\mathcal{L}_{\Lambda}w_{1+\infty}$ algebra. Free scalar and Dirac theories yield the same one-particle light-ray action. This action extends to the critical $O(N)$ model at $N=\infty$, while regulated moments reproduce the pairwise algebra in the large-but-finite-$N$ correlators studied here. In the celestial hard-graviton module, the projected null conditions select $\Delta=3$ uniquely, and a closed raising subalgebra annihilates $G^+_3$ exactly. The nonzero-$\Lambda$ quadratic Casimir has eigenvalue three throughout the hard module, and the exact annihilators and low-spin Ward identities give compatible differential-difference equations for celestial correlators.

2608.25239v1.title: Single-Minus Graviton Amplitudes from Matrix Theory
2608.25239v1.abstract: The $n$-point single-minus graviton amplitudes are nonzero in a special kinematic region that preserves some supersymmetry when embedded in supergravity. We compute these amplitudes within the BFSS matrix theory by relating them to an index problem considered by A. Sen. More precisely, the single-minus amplitudes are obtained from an index that counts BPS states in the Coulomb branch of four-dimensional ${\cal N}=4$ super Yang-Mills. We explicitly check this relation in a specific kinematic region by computing the index using BPS wall-crossing formulae and matching it to the gravity result. We further employ BPS wall-crossing to show that the index satisfies a tower of $w_{1+\infty}$ soft theorems in any kinematic regime, again matching gravity. Finally, we show that for certain kinematics, the single-minus amplitudes can be realized by scattering a graviton off a plane wave.

2608.25287v1.title: Beyond Strong Subadditivity: Holographic Entropy Inequalities Along Renormalization Group Flows
2608.25287v1.abstract: Strong subadditivity (SSA) on a common light cone gives the Casini-Huerta entropic proof of the three-dimensional $F$-theorem. We ask whether holographic entropy inequalities beyond SSA similarly constrain renormalization group flows for which every intermediate theory admits a semiclassical holographic description. For small, disjoint deformations of a common light-cone region, we show that the second-order response of a broad class of balanced holographic inequalities depends only on pairwise correlations already controlled by SSA. A six-party example shows that the full finite inequality nevertheless contains genuinely multipartite information, so its disappearance is a limitation of the second-order expansion rather than of the inequality itself. Two natural finite constructions do not recover the missing information. We nevertheless find two ways in which information beyond SSA survives. A five-party inequality bounds the rate at which a conditional correlation grows as one region is enlarged. Separately, a continuum limit of the odd-cyclic inequalities gives a constraint on the angular shape dependence of entanglement entropy, and Lorentz symmetry relates this constraint to radial evolution. Thus holographic entropy inequalities beyond SSA do constrain entanglement along RG flows, although we do not obtain a second universal analogue of the $F$-function.

classification.title_zh: 超越强次可加性：沿重整化群流的全息熵不等式
classification.abstract_zh: 在共同光锥上的强次可加性（SSA）给出了三维 F-定理的 Casini-Huerta 熵证明。我们研究超越 SSA 的全息熵不等式是否也能约束那些每一个中间理论都具有半经典全息描述的重整化群流。对于共同光锥区域的小且不重叠的形变，我们表明一大类平衡全息不等式的二阶响应仅依赖于已经被 SSA 控制的成对关联。一个六方例子表明，完整的有限不等式仍然包含真正的多体信息，因此该信息的消失是二阶展开的局限，而非不等式本身的局限。两种自然的有限构造无法恢复缺失的信息。然而，我们发现超越 SSA 的信息以两种方式存活。一个五方不等式限制了当一个区域扩大时条件关联的增长速率。另外，奇循环不等式的连续极限给出了对纠缠熵角向形状依赖的约束，且洛伦兹对称性将该约束与径向演化联系起来。因此，超越 SSA 的全息熵不等式确实约束了沿 RG 流的纠缠，尽管我们没有得到第二个普适的 F 函数类比物。
